desc:
👍 LIKE GOAL: 100 LIKES = FREE LIMITED HARMONICA 🎵 + 3 💎 FOR EVERYONE!

🆕 SKELETON ISLAND + RED SEA UPDATE ☠️ – Captain boss, treasure, merchant, Cutlass & Revive Potion!

🌊 Your ship is SINKING! You have 1 MINUTE to grab supplies, save your crew and escape on a tiny boat... then survive the open sea as long as you can!

⏰ 1 MINUTE – Scavenge the sinking ship for food, water, tools and crew
🎲 140+ RANDOM EVENTS – sea monsters, storms, ghost ships, UFOs, floating treasure and tough choices
🎬 40+ CUTSCENES – every encounter comes to life
🎮 20+ MINIGAMES – fish, bail water, pick locks, fight giant tentacles and more
🏝️ EXPLORE – tropical islands, a haunted lighthouse, a frozen tundra full of wolves and sunken shipwrecks
👥 CO-OP 1-4 PLAYERS – vote together, share supplies, save each other
🐕 Adopt a dog, recruit 6 crew classes, unlock 20+ perks & gear

Every run is different. How many days can YOU survive? 🌅
